## Cream Ball

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/cream_ball.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user throws a ball of cream where they look. It hits the first enemy in its way, burns it and slows it for a moment.

## Cream Grab

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/cream_grab.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

A tentacle of cream shoots at the enemy the user looks at, burns it and pulls it to the user. It pulls it off its mount or boat too.

## Cream Flood

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/cream_flood.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user spreads cream on the ground around them. Enemies that walk in it are slowed and burnt by the cream again and again. Using it again takes the cream back.

## Cream Monster

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/cream_monster.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

A puddle of cream spreads around the user and follows them. Tentacles spring out of it at the enemies that come close, burn them and hold them for a moment. It holds less on players and bosses. The user keeps moving and using other abilities while it lasts. Inside Cream Shell the tentacles stay in the puddle.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 25 s (500 ticks) |
| Base damage | 6 HP |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 1.75× |

</div>

## Cream Shell

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/cream_shell.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user shuts themselves in a thick shell of cream. Inside it the user takes almost no damage but can't move, can't attack and can't use other abilities of the fruit. Whoever hits the shell with a bare hand is burnt. The shell breaks after stopping enough damage.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 20 s (400 ticks) |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 1.75× |

</div>


<!-- move inomissing:cream_body -->

## Cream Body

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/cream_body.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

The body of the user is always covered with cream. Whoever hits the user with a bare hand is burnt by the cream. Hitting the user with a weapon does not burn. The cream of every ability burns. The burn hurts 2 every second, each touch of cream makes it last longer up to 10 seconds and water washes it off. What fire can't hurt the cream can't burn.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">
